item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] It's time to meet the furry contenders participating in Fat Marmot Week
item.description: Marmots bulk up all summer long to survive the winter and now will face head to head in a similar format to Fat Bear Week.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Community shaken after Mississippi woman, Tasia Fortune, found hanging from a tree
item.description: The hanging death of Tasia Fortune, whose body was found outside an abandoned house, has shaken her family and community in Mississippi.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Colombia searches for over 3,000 missing after a powerful earthquake kills more than 100
item.description: Search and rescue efforts resumed Tuesday in dozens of cities and towns in western Colombia after a powerful earthquake left over 3,000 missing, with many trapped under the debris.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] FTC reports social media scams caused more than $90 million in losses in 2025
item.description: The Federal Trade Commission has reported that social media ad scams caused more than $90 million in losses last year.

item.title: [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] 4 'violent' Mexican cartel members accused of trading drugs for military weapons in Czech Republic: DOJ
item.description: Four members of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel, one of Mexico's most powerful and violent drug organizations, are facing federal charges after they were arrested in the Czech Republic. The men are accused of trying to buy military weapons with drugs trafficked into the United States, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office.
